'''Morly Hardlin''' is an [[Asha'man]] who has reached the rank of Dedicated.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Morly Hardin}}

==Activities==
He was involved in the capturing and [[bonding]] of the fifty-one [[Aes Sedai]] sent from the [[White Tower]]. He is a part of [[Logain Ablar]]'s group.

He bonded [[Lemai Ambani]] of the [[Red Ajah]].
